curatedMovie.curiosityHook: After three years without answers, what will Rex do when letters from Saskia's abductor arrive?
curatedMovie.description: While on vacation, Saskia vanishes from a busy service station in broad daylight. Three years later, with no answers or closure in sight, Rex suddenly starts receiving letters from her abductor.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow, heavy, and intensely suspenseful mystery best taken in alone with full attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: George Sluizer crafts a deliberate, deeply unsettling thriller that turns an agonizing mystery into an obsessive, slow-burning search for answers.
